title: Preparation of a holidic medium for Drosophila melanogaster
protocol: Purchase ingredients according to the order sheet.
Prepare each of the stock solutions using the quantities and directions shown in Tables 2, 3, and 4.
In a 1L autoclave-proof glass bottle, mark the level for the target pre-autoclave volume (1 litre minus the sum of the ingredients added after autoclaving).
Add a magnetic stirrer flea to the bottle.
To milliQ water, add sucrose and low solubility amino acids (L, I, Y).
Add stock solutions for buffer base and metal ions.
Add cholesterol stock solution; solution will turn cloudy.
Autoclave at 120 °C for 15 minutes simultaneously with dispensing tubing and glass vials or bottles to house the medium.
Allow solution to cool at room temperature with stirring to ~65 °C.
Add sterile stock solutions in order: amino acids, nucleosides/choline/inositol mix, vitamins, and preservatives.
Using sterile tubing, dispense the solution into sterile vials.
Cover the vials and allow to cool for 90 minutes at room temperature.
